run.suite: fix verification - the three journeys that failed on the previous build

fixes.LC-03: issue #8 - rememberSaveable for the picker flag
fixes.AX-02: issue #9 - the toggle label is picked on task.isCompleted

run.note: Each journey also carries regression checks beyond its own actions: that Undo still works inside the shortened window, that Cancel still dismisses the picker, and that unfinished rows still read "Mark complete". All held.

results.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox

Verify that the checkbox on every unfinished row is described as "Mark complete"

results.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row now has an unchecked checkbox described as "Mark complete"
